title: List the operating steps in order
goal: Change a paragraph of instructions for returning a bicycle into sequential steps.
summary: ol is used for items whose order affects the meaning. The browser will display the numbers in the order of li.
tasks: Change the paragraph under the title into an ordered list ol.
uses three li's to write "Find the return point" "Park the bicycle into the empty space" "Lock the car and confirm the return" in sequence.
hint: checks the sequence of three li. ol will be numbered automatically, and you only need to write the step text in li.

example.code:
1. Connect the video cable
  2. switch to the corresponding input source
  3. Check the screen projection
example.note: conference room require sequential operations, so they are recorded in an ordered list.
